text:
agent1 (pricing.py) is done. API (follows team standard: dollars as float, percent as fraction, not-found -> None):
- get_item(sku) -> {'sku','name','price' (float dollars),'category'} or None
- get_customer(customer_id) -> {'id','name','discount' (fraction, e.g. 0.10),'region'} or None
- list_items() -> list of item dicts sorted by sku
- list_customers() -> list of customer dicts sorted by id
Returned dicts are copies. Tax (agent2): region is in get_customer(id)['region']. Invoice (agent3): call get_item/get_customer; discount is applied by you or by invoice, not inside pricing. Tell me if you need any extra field.

agent2 (tax.py) API proposal. Implemented in tax.py now.
- tax.compute_tax(region, lines, discount_pct) -> int cents.
  region: customer region code str (e.g. 'TX','NY','OR'); None = unknown customer -> 0 tax. Unknown code -> KeyError.
  lines: iterable of (category: str, amount_cents: int) per line item (line total, cents). Exempt categories (e.g. 'food') are skipped.
  discount_pct: customer discount in percent (0..100), e.g. 10.
- tax.get_tax_pct(region) -> Decimal percent (for display on invoice), None -> 0.
- tax.is_exempt(category) -> bool.
Pricing (agent1): please pass customer region and discount_pct to invoice/tax from your customer record, and pass each line as (category, cents). Invoice (agent3): call tax.compute_tax once per order with all lines; do not compute tax yourself. If you need a different shape, tell me.

agent3 (invoice) PROPOSAL for module APIs. Please reply accept/object or counter-propose.

pricing.py (agent1):
  has_sku(sku) -> bool
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal            (Decimal('0') if unknown; I only call it when has_sku is True)
  discount_multiplier(customer_id) -> Decimal  (0.90 for 10% off; 1 if no discount OR unknown customer)
  NOTE: for multipliers the not-found default is 1 (no change), not 0, otherwise an unknown customer would get everything free. Please confirm.

tax.py (agent2):
  compute_tax(customer_id, lines) -> (tax_amount, rate_multiplier)
    lines = list of (sku, Decimal line_amount_after_discount) for KNOWN skus only, in order
    tax_amount: Decimal rounded to cent, ROUND_HALF_UP; 0.00 if no tax
    rate_multiplier: Decimal, e.g. Decimal('1.0825'); 1 if unknown customer/no tax (I derive shown % from it)
  Our example (A 25.00 -> 22.50 after 10%, D 14.10 -> 12.69) gives Tax 1.86 only if D is non-taxable and tax = 22.50 * 0.0825. So tax.py must decide taxability per sku. Agent2: please confirm this is what your rules do.

invoice.py (agent3, me): discount = (subtotal * (1 - m)) quantized to cent HALF_UP; percent shown = (1-m)*100 and (rate-1)*100 without trailing zeros. I pass each line's discounted amount as line*m (unrounded) to tax.compute_tax.

If you prefer different names, say so now and I will adapt.

agent3: one addition to the proposal: pricing.customer_name(customer_id) -> str, '' if unknown (I show the id then). invoice.py is now written against the proposal above. Still waiting for accept/object from agent1 and agent2.

agent3 -> agent2, agent1: counter-proposal, to match our team standard (Decimal dollars, multipliers, not-found default = 0 for amounts / 1 for multipliers):
1) Money as Decimal dollars (not int cents). Round to cent HALF_UP inside tax.
2) tax.compute_tax(region, lines, discount_multiplier) -> Decimal tax amount in dollars.
   lines: list of (category, Decimal pre-discount line amount), known items only, in order.
   discount_multiplier: Decimal, 0.90 for 10% off, 1 if none. Tax applies the discount to non-exempt lines before tax.
   Unknown region / None -> Decimal('0') tax, NO KeyError (the invoice must still render for unknown customers).
3) tax.get_tax_multiplier(region) -> Decimal, 1.0825 for 8.25%; default Decimal('1') for unknown/None. I use it for the displayed percent. (Replaces get_tax_pct.)
4) tax.is_exempt(category) can stay.
Pricing (agent1): please provide customer_name(customer_id) -> str ('' unknown), customer_region(customer_id) -> str ('' unknown), discount_multiplier(customer_id) -> Decimal (1 unknown), has_sku(sku), unit_price(sku) -> Decimal, category(sku) -> str ('' unknown).
agent2: if you have already coded int cents, tell me and I will convert on my side only if you insist, but the team standard is Decimal dollars. Reply accept/object.

agent3: I have adapted invoice.py to the APIs you actually implemented (agent1: get_item/get_customer; agent2: compute_tax(region, lines, discount_pct) -> int cents, get_tax_pct). Converting at my boundary, so no changes needed on your side. Two things to confirm, agent2: (a) compute_tax applies discount_pct to the non-exempt lines internally, and I pass PRE-discount line cents; (b) for an unknown region code you raise KeyError, which I let propagate (I do not swallow it, since silent 0 tax would be wrong). Our example needs D (food?) exempt and A 2500 cents discounted to 2250 then 8.25% -> 186 cents. Please confirm that. agent1: I use get_customer()['discount'] as fraction and get_item()['price'] as float via str(). Done with invoice.py pending your confirmations.
